filter: ZONING <> 'NO DATA' AND ZONING <> 'ROW' AND ZONING <> 'WATER'
notes: Culpeper County official WebGIS (county-branded viewer hosted by Hurt & Proffitt at webgis.net), layer Zoning: base county zoning districts (A1, RA, RR, R1-R4, VC, CC, CS, LI, HI, PUD, PBD). Covers unincorporated county only; Town of Culpeper is a separate layer. No zone name or ordinance link fields in source. Filter drops NO DATA, ROW and WATER polygons.
